🌏 About Us

CyaniAgent is an open-source team dedicated to pursuing ultimate aesthetics and high-performance technology.

Here is what defines us:

  • 🏛️ Our Heritage: CyaniAgent was originally the technical group within iMikufans. While we have evolved into an independent open team, we maintain a close friendship and collaborative relationship with iMikufans to drive community growth together.
  • 🤝 Global Vision: We warmly welcome developers from all over the world! We are committed to building an international, open, inclusive, and collaborative space. Here, code has no borders, and creativity knows no bounds.

🛠️ Core Tech Stack

Our projects span across mobile, desktop, and system levels, primarily utilizing the following languages and technologies:

Area Technologies
Mobile & UI
System & Backend

💡 Ecosystem & Inspiration

We are deeply influenced by the open-source philosophy. We pay tribute to and draw heavy inspiration from the core architecture and development patterns of:

  • 🪐 Misskey: Decentralized social protocol and architecture.
  • 💬 Flarum: Modern, lightweight forum architecture.

We strive to build superior clients and extension tools for these ecosystems.

🌟 Featured Projects

Project Description Stack
📱 CyaniTalk Unified Social Client<br>Seamlessly connects Misskey and Flarum, providing a modern social experience. Flutter Rust
